'''Cestus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was also an [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] of the [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Cestus was killed in [[3637 BBY]] when a Republic strike team was [[Korriban Incursion|sent to secure]] Sith [[Datacron/Legends|datacrons]] and [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]] on Korriban.<ref name="Incursion" />
